fit_reason: Whole pickup truck listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Exterior paint on the doors and bed sides looks fairly glossy but shows some light dullness and possible water spotting under overcast light
Black plastic rear bumper step and lower trim look slightly faded/grayish
Light dust and debris on the driver floor mat and rear floor mat
Some light wear and dust on the driver seat bolster and steering wheel area
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Colorado and it already looks well kept. A wash and wax plus some attention to the black rear bumper trim and the floor mats would help it pop a little more in photos and in person. We do pre-sale details and come to you. Would you like a quote?
